description: Metadata for public Data & Society HTML pages about artificial intelligence on datasociety.net. Each stored URL was confirmed with one bounded GET that returned HTML. A challenge page, non-HTML response, or redirect off that host is not stored. Rows store the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page bodies, abstracts, PDFs, quotes, and chart data are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. creative_commons means only CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA. CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, and CC BY-NC-ND stay unknown. uk_ogl is only for the Open Government Licence. us_government_work is only when a rights field says the item is a US government work. runner_wired is false.
